name: ZomVox
storyline: A chain of remote voxel islands has gone silent after an experimental signal tower network started broadcasting corrupted audio pulses. The signal, nicknamed the ZomVox, turns island wildlife and stranded workers into blocky infected. Mission Command drops you onto each island to shut down the contamination source, recover supplies, and clear the infected before the signal spreads.
summary:
ZomVox is a free browser voxel zombie FPS built around quick survival hunts and mission-based island drops. Players explore blocky biomes, disable contamination sources, unlock perks, collect ammo and C4, and fight off waves of infected voxel zombies.
The game features story drops, quick hunt mode, unlockable islands, biome variety, zombie variants, ambient audio, mobile-friendly controls, and installable PWA support for fullscreen play.
